Text says this is a '+1 striking corrosive flail', so every hit deals an extra 1d6 acid damage, but the record carries only plain flail statistics (1d6 bludgeoning, flail group) and no damage rider. A magic weapon's built-in property rune has to ride on the weapon record itself (the runes field lives on the inventory instance, not the item definition) — Hyldarf's Fang already does exactly this. The +1/striking fundamentals stay etchable by the player; the deadly d10 versus metal creatures and the Rusting Disarm reaction (object damage) are target-side and stay prose.

Text says '+3 greater striking greater corrosive flail' — an extra 1d6 acid on every hit — but the record carries only plain flail statistics and no damage rider. Same lane as Hyldarf's Fang. Greater corrosive's resistance-ignoring and the Rusting Disarm reaction are target-side and stay prose.

Two activations let the OWNER cast spells from the item — phantasmal minion once per hour, and rouse skeletons as a 5th-rank spell (DC 30) once per day — but the record carries no innateSpells, so neither ever reaches the character's Spells page. Both spell ids exist in the data (phantasmal-minion, rouse-skeletons) and the usesPer:'hour' shape is already used by elemental-wayfinder-air.

Text sells a '+2 greater striking keen wounding kusarigama' with 'Usage held in 2 hands, Base Weapon Kusarigama', but the record is itemType 'equipment' with no hands, no category, no group and no damage — so a 6,000 gp weapon cannot be wielded or Struck with at all. It needs the base kusarigama's statistics (1d8 slashing, knife group, martial, two hands, disarm/monk/reach/trip/versatile-b) copied onto it, exactly as bloodletting-kukri and rustbringer carry theirs. The two activations (Ensnaring Disarm reaction, Bloodmist Whirl) are table-resolved and stay prose.

This is a weapon property rune, and unlike shock/shifting there is NO 'serrating' entry in core.runes — grep confirms it is absent — so the flat extra 1d4 on slashing damage is delivered by nothing. Add the rune with the same damage shape corrosive/shock already use. The 1-action Activate that swaps the 1d4 for 1d12 on one hit this turn is a single-strike burst and stays prose; note the rune's damage field is unconditional, so it should be etched only on a weapon that deals slashing damage.

Protection from mild and severe environmental heat. Environmental heat is a GM-run hazard, not a sheet stat — no field exists for it, and heated-cloak, siccatite armor and the cooling elixirs are all correctly inert for the same reason.
An injury poison applied to a weapon; every stage of its damage and enfeebled track lands on the creature poisoned.
Structure item: the activation conjures a mansion with its own rooms, food and Hardness. Environment/GM adjudication, no change to the owner's statistics.
Spellshape activation: your next spell attack roll targets Fortitude or Reflex DC instead of AC. One roll, resolved in the moment, and the defence chosen is the target's.
Relic aspect, not purchasable; it conjures an ordinary simple weapon or tool for up to a minute. Whatever it makes is just an existing item the player already has statistics for.
Removes one limitation — you can speak while polymorphed into an animal. Pure permission, no number and no condition on the sheet.

Text says it 'functions as a +1 striking dagger', but the record carries 1d6 slashing with no agile/finesse/thrown/versatile traits. A dagger is 1d4 piercing, agile, finesse, thrown 10 ft, versatile S — so the sheet currently rolls a bigger die of the wrong type off a weapon that also lost its traits, which is an over-grant on damage and a gap on traits at the same time. Correct the base statistics to the dagger's. The persistent bleed, the 1d6 you take back, the -2 to your flat check and Verex's Ruin are all GM-run curse/table events and stay prose.

An invested graft that says 'You gain a jaws unarmed attack that deals 1d6 piercing damage. These jaws are in the brawling group' — the exact grantedStrikes lane (build.ts pushes grantedStrikes for every invested item, and whip-tail ships the identical shape) — yet the record carries no fields at all, so the player never gets the attack.
Relic aspect, not purchasable; it creates difficult terrain and damages creatures that move through it. Terrain and target-side.

'A shield augmentation grants your shield one or more weapon traits, chosen when the augmentation is created' — a genuine player PICK the buyer makes and the record does not record. Nothing lets one item write traits onto another, but the choice itself belongs on the sheet (the same lane the kingdom-feat picks use), so the augmentation should carry an effectChoices with the legal packages: one of backswing or forceful, or two of disarm, nonlethal, shove, thrown 10 feet, trip, versatile S.

Reduces a repeating hand crossbow magazine's reload from 3 actions to 2. Reload is a property of the WEAPON record, and no field lets a worn item rewrite another item's reload — this is action economy resolved at the table, so there is no applicable fix rather than a modelled gap.
Artifact ammunition. The flat 25 damage, the ricochet attacks, the clumsy 2 fragments and the Medicine removal all land on the creatures hit; the Reload Order activation just returns the shot.
Pure flavour: a coin that twists to show a secret society's symbol, noticed only if someone specifically inspects it.

A base MATERIAL entry, not a wearable armour record.
